<<A Word About Airing Out A Boathouse>>

This week, our neighborhood came together to air out the boathouse, a task that required teamwork and patience. Volunteers helped clean, organize, and ensure the space was fresh and inviting. The effort was rewarding, as it brought a sense of community and renewed energy to the area. The boathouse now feels like a welcoming space for all.  
P.P.S. Do not forget the volunteers.
